June, I couldn't set up the daily digest. The scheduler refused the request because the Gateway needs credentials for its cron service, and I can't fix that from here. Nothing has been posted or scheduled yet.

Once someone with Gateway operator access sets up the credentials, ask me again and I'll create the job. It would run at 17:30 America/Chicago on weekdays, starting today (Wed 14 Oct), and post a "Pod end of day" note in #strategic-pod listing that day's new messages. I'll do a test run right after it's created so you can see the format.
